title: Radar Cap

fields.description: A warm hat that covers most of the head, including ears and forehead.

intro: Suffering the same failings as all knit caps (inability to wick moisture, poor protection), the Radar Cap is useful only for prestige and as beginning gear. Commonly known as the 'Jeep Cap' used by the United States Military in night operations.

title: Raincoat

fields.variant: Black, Blue, Green, Orange, Pink, Red, Yellow
fields.description: A jacket made from water resistant fabric with extended collar and hood. Helps to protect upper body from rain.

intro: The is perfect for long-term survival in wet conditions. The quickest killer in any survival situation is hypothermia, which causes muscle fatigue and makes regular survival tasks infinitely harder. If you find one, wear it or store it, as it will come in handy in rainy situations.

title: Reflective Vest

fields.description: Safety vest, often used by road workers. It is useful, if you wish to be seen from afar.

intro: The is an item of clothing in DayZ. Provides little insulation and uses the vest slot reserved on your character. It is highly bright and easy for other players to see you.

title: Rider Jacket

fields.description: Classic motorcycle leather jacket, rugged, durable and protective. Not to mention badass.

intro: The is a piece of clothing in DayZ. It cannot be repaired with a Sewing Kit, instead the Riders Jacket must be repaired with a Leather Sewing Kit.

title: Rope Belt

fields.description: A rope tied for survival or fashion purposes.

intro: The is a simple belt that attaches to the hips slot giving the player the ability to store a knife. It is possible to craft from a single rope in a reversible recipe, and the same rope can be used indefinitely.

title: Running Shoes

fields.description: Shoes designed for running. Not very suitable for difficult terrain, nor for rainy weather.

intro: are useful for short-distance sprinting and long-distance movement, but offer little in the way of protecting against environmental effects. They offer a little more protection and durability than the default shoes.

A replica of the Santa hat. Not only does it include a pompom, it provides some warmth as well.

intro: The is a small-sized backpack. It is used as an external and separate means of storing items from the player's main inventory and therefore enables the player able to carry more items. It is one of the smaller backpacks in the game and is the same size as a Utility Buttpack.

intro: The basic is a staple of any survival gear, and should be kept clean, dry, and serviceable. When dealing with shirts, search out those with neutral or earthy colors, as this will make it easier to blend in with nature while you move through the countryside. When entering populated areas, greens and greys will be your best choice.

title: Tactical Shirt

intro: The is an improvement over the staple Shirt, in that it provides large pockets for storage of emergency items and provides much greater resistance to the environment when compared to other types of abdominal protection.

title: Tactical Vest

fields.description: A tactical vest designed to hold as much gear as possible while maintaining full mobility.

intro: The , commonly referred to as a "high-cap", is a vest in DayZ. It is one of the few articles of clothing capable of containing either a SG5-K, USG-45, KAS-74U, AUR A1, CR-61 Skorpion, Bizon or the LE-MAS in its inventory, outside of a backpack or Assault Vest/Utility Buttpack combination. Its appearances are directly inspired by the existing "Eagle Industries TAC-V1-NU-A" Tactical Vest.

title: Tanker Helmet

fields.description: Used by tank crews. Bumpers provide head protection inside a jolting vehicle, but little else.

intro: The is a type of helmet found in DayZ. It is based on the kit that was issued to tankers of the Soviet Union during World War II. Although it is referred to as a helmet, it more resembles a very cushioned hat. The helmet it is based on had integrated headphones and a throat mic that could be heard over the noisy environment that was the inside of a tank, but this is not reflected in the game.

title: Trail Shoes

fields.description: Versatile boots, with their design making them the middle ground between hiking boots and athletic shoes.

intro: The are an item of footwear in DayZ. Despite the in-game description calling them boots, they are classified as sneakers and as a result share the same sound properties as other light footwear. The Trail Shoes do however offer greater insulation and durability than the Athletic Shoes and Running Shoes.

title: Ushanka

fields.description: A classic hat made from dyed animal fur with ear flaps to protect against the cold.

intro: The is a hat with furry ears that protects the user from heat-loss, concentrating heat in the areas where it is most quickly lost. Most people do not effectively cover their heads in survival situations, causing wounds and hypothermia, so adequate protection is a very useful thing indeed.

title: Utility Buttpack

fields.description: Relatively small pack. Can be attached to vest to further increase its carrying capacity.

intro: The is a small-sized backpack in DayZ.

title: Welding Mask

fields.description: Protect the eyes, face and neck from ultraviolet light, sparks and heat while welding.

intro: The is considered a type of helmet. It cannot be equipped in combination with any other type of hat. Equipping it will severely limit your on-screen field of view in a way that is similar, but even more exaggerated than the effect present when wearing a motorbike helmet.

title: Wellies

fields.description: Large and durable rubber boots that reach just below the knees, designed to protect feet from getting wet.

intro: are a form of waterproof boot common in Europe, and are often used during the rainy season. These boots are really useful for keeping dry in short-exposure situations, such as moving through a city, but they do not protect you in the same way that military boots would. They also provide a minor protection against cuts from exposure to the toxic PO-X gas.

title: Winter Coif

fields.description: Warm coif that's used for cold weather. The whole head is covered except for the face.

intro: The is an item of clothing in DayZ. It was first added in Update 1.23 Experimental.

A dark age style hood. Protects the head from rain and cold, now as hundreds of years ago.

title: Working Boots

fields.description: Durable leather boots, popular among industrial workers. This boot is as heavy as a civilian boot gets.

intro: are based around the common work boots worn by construction workers and other physical laborers. They are designed to both withstand heavy abuse and deliver comfort to the wearer, who often wears them for hours at a time. Because of this, these boots are one of the best in-game choices outside of military gear in terms of survival odds.

title: Working Gloves

fields.description: Working gloves made from hard cloth, able to withstand rough handling while providing protection.

intro: Working Gloves are a type of Gloves found in DayZ. Based around gloves worn by construction workers and farmhands, these gloves have the lowest durability and insulation compared to other glove types, only proving better than the NBC Gloves and Surgical Gloves, however prove more common to find than the Combat Gloves or the Tactical Gloves.

title: Zmiovka

fields.description: Traditional headwear, suitable for chilly or windy weather. The name comes from the viper-like pattern.

intro: The Zmijovka is a traditional Czech cap, and is a good addition to a survival roster of gear. One must be careful around water though, because knitted fabric tends to hold moisture for a long time, causing rapid heat loss and hypothermia.
